description: Accessible modal dialog built on Radix UI DialogPrimitive. Composed of Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogPortal, DialogOverlay, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, and DialogDescription for flexible layout.
useCases: Survey creation and editing forms presented in a focused modal context
Detailed view of a response or result without leaving the current page
Configuration panels for survey settings, sharing options, or integrations
Confirmation prompts and informational overlays requiring user acknowledgment
